member.summary: Decoder for the AWS application/vnd.amazon.eventstream binary framing used by Bedrock's ConverseStream / InvokeModelWithResponseStream responses. Unlike the SSE/NDJSON streams every other provider uses, this is a length-prefixed binary protocol: each message is a 12-byte prelude (total length, headers length, prelude CRC-32), a headers block, a payload, and a trailing message CRC-32.
